display.purpose: h1 page titles only; rendered with the brand gradient. Compact (20px) by design.

body.purpose: Default content; cap measure at 65-75ch in prose.

label.purpose: Metadata, form labels, hints; Muted Ink.

shadows.name: flat-default
shadows.purpose: All surfaces at rest. Cards and panels carry no shadow; the --shadow-* tokens are intentionally zeroed.

shadows.name: spin-glow
shadows.purpose: The spin button only. Animates to 0.55/0.35 at the pulse-glow peak.

shadows.name: modal-float
shadows.purpose: Winner reveal and modal dialogs — floating emphasis above the dimmed stage.

motion.name: spin-ease
motion.purpose: The wheel spin — long ease-out, 4-5s with +/-0.5s variance, gentle settle on landing.

motion.name: pulse-glow
motion.purpose: Spin button aura breathing while idle and ready.

motion.name: idle-breathe
motion.purpose: Subtle life on the idle hero.

motion.name: slide-in-right
motion.purpose: Panel/list item entrances from the right.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default call to action — Spotlight Violet, tactile lift on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 Inter, 'Open Sans', sans-serif; color: #FAFAFA; background: #7C3AED; border: 1px solid #6a2fd4; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.94); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #7C3AED; }

components.name: Spin Button
components.description: The marquee CTA — primary violet with the signature breathing glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-spin { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 40px; font: 700 1rem/1 Inter, 'Open Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #FAFAFA; background: #7C3AED; border: none; border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(139,92,246,0.4), 0 8px 30px rgba(99,102,241,0.2); animation: ds-pulse-glow 2.5s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse-glow { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(139,92,246,0.4), 0 8px 30px rgba(99,102,241,0.2); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 4px 25px rgba(139,92,246,0.55), 0 8px 40px rgba(99,102,241,0.35); } } .ds-btn-spin:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-spin { animation: none; } }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — transparent, inherits surface, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 Inter, 'Open Sans', sans-serif; color: #FAFAFA; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .ds-btn-outline:active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #7C3AED; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field — semi-transparent fill, branded violet focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 Inter, 'Open Sans', sans-serif; color: #FAFAFA; background: rgba(15,23,42,0.5); border: 1px solid #404040; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A6A6A6; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #7C3AED; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(124,58,237,0.5); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat panel — Studio Black with a whisper of glass and a hairline border. No shadow.

components.name: Header Nav
components.description: Top app bar — gradient title left, ghost icon actions right, hairline base.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 16px; background: #0F172A; border-bottom: 1px solid #292929; } .ds-nav-title { font: 700 1.25rem/1.2 Inter, 'Open Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #B44AFF, #F43F8A, #0099FF); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; } .ds-nav-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; color: #FAFAFA; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-icon:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .ds-nav-icon:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #7C3AED; }

narrative.overview: QuickWheel is a dark studio with one thing lit: the wheel. Everything else recedes into the low light so the spin can carry the stage. The deep navy-charcoal background is the unlit theater; the violet-to-pink-to-blue brand gradient is the stage lighting, used sparingly and only where it earns a moment. The spin itself is the show. This is premium broadcast energy: confident, polished, with a deliberate wink of fun. The system is restrained by construction: surfaces are flat at rest, shadows are globally zeroed, and depth comes from interaction and from two signature glows. Color is rationed so the bright gradient reads as premium rather than garish.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first stage; the wheel is the only fully-lit element.
Brand gradient as stage lighting -- rare, deliberate, never wallpaper.
Flat-by-default surfaces; depth earned through interaction and signature glows.
Compact, confident typography that yields the spotlight to the wheel.
Tactile components that respond to touch via a brightness-lift elevate system.

rules.name: The Stage Lighting Rule
rules.body: The brand gradient is lighting, not paint. It appears on <=10% of any screen -- a title, one CTA, a celebration. The moment it tiles a background or repeats per-card, it stops reading as premium and starts reading as the casino tool we reject.

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Exactly one accent hue (Spotlight Violet) carries interactivity across the whole product. Status colors are functional signals only, never decoration.

rules.name: The Gradient-Title Rule
rules.body: The brand gradient on text is reserved for the single h1 page title per screen. Never apply background-clip: text to body copy, card titles, or labels.

rules.name: The Quiet Chrome Rule
rules.body: No display type exceeds 20px in the app shell. If a heading wants to be bigger, the wheel should be bigger instead.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow on a card is a bug. Depth appears only as a response to hover, to significance (the three signature glows), or to modality.

dos: Do keep the wheel the single lit hero of every screen it appears on; quiet the chrome around it.
Do ration the brand gradient to <=10% of a screen -- a title, one CTA, a celebration.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; earn depth through hover-elevate/active-elevate-2 and the three signature glows only.
Do use border-border (Hairline) for all borders so they adapt to light/dark -- never border-white/10.
Do hold body and placeholder text to >=4.5:1 contrast; bump Muted Ink toward Ink if it drifts close.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: the spin, pulse-glow, idle-breathe, and slide-ins all need a crossfade-or-instant fallback.
Do indicate the winner by pointer position + label highlight, not color alone.
Do use size=icon for icon-only buttons; let the component own its dimensions.
donts: Don't drift toward the cheap, ad-stuffed 'spin to win' casino aesthetic -- no garish flashing, no fake-prize urgency, no neon stacking.
Don't let the app collapse into a generic SaaS dashboard -- identical card grids, cards-everywhere, zero personality.
Don't go childish / clip-art -- no Comic Sans, no primary-color clip art, no kids'-toy energy.
Don't ship flat and lifeless -- a static form that happens to spin. Motion and depth are the product.
Don't put a drop shadow on a card; if it looks like a 2014 Material card, the shadow is the bug.
Don't apply the gradient background-clip: text to anything but the single h1 page title.
Don't nest cards or use border-left/border-right >1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't exceed 20px display type in the app shell; make the wheel bigger instead.
